title: Conditional Statements in Shell
title_vi: Câu Lệnh Điều Kiện If-Else Trong Shell
overview: Learn if, else, elif, numeric comparisons (-eq, -gt), string comparisons, and logical operators.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.
sections.hint: Thực hiện theo yêu cầu và kiểm tra kết quả trên hệ thống.

sections.title: Create Your First If Statement
sections.title_vi: Viết câu lệnh if đầu tiên
sections.content:
Write if.sh: compare NAME=John and execute the matching branch.

`~/project/if.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
NAME="John"
if [ "$NAME" = "John" ]; then
  echo "The name is John"
fi
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/if.sh
~/project/if.sh 
```
sections.content_vi:
Viết if.sh: so sánh NAME=John rồi chạy nhánh phù hợp.

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/if.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['if', 'NAME=', 'fi']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['The name is John']),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Numeric Comparisons
sections.content:
Create numeric.sh using -lt, -eq and -gt, initially NUMBER=10.

`~/project/numeric.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
NUMBER=10
if [ "$NUMBER" -lt 5 ]; then echo "The number is less than 5"
elif [ "$NUMBER" -eq 10 ]; then echo "The number is exactly 10"
elif [ "$NUMBER" -gt 15 ]; then echo "The number is greater than 15"
else echo "The number is between 5 and 15, but not 10"
fi
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/numeric.sh
~/project/numeric.sh 
```

sections.title: String Comparisons and Logical Operators
sections.title_vi: So sánh chuỗi và toán tử logic
sections.content:
Use string_logic.sh to compare strings, combine conditions and detect an unset variable.

`~/project/string_logic.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
STRING1="hello"; STRING2="world"; NUMBER1=5; NUMBER2=10
if [ "$STRING1" = hello ] && [ "$STRING2" = world ]; then echo "Both strings match"; fi
if [ "$NUMBER1" -lt 10 ] || [ "$NUMBER2" -gt 5 ]; then echo "At least one of the number conditions is true"; fi
if [[ "$STRING1" != "$STRING2" ]]; then echo "The strings are different"; fi
if [[ -z "$STRING3" ]]; then echo "STRING3 is empty or not set"; fi
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/string_logic.sh
~/project/string_logic.sh 
```
sections.content_vi:
Dùng string_logic.sh so sánh chuỗi, kết hợp điều kiện và nhận biết biến chưa đặt.

steps.title_vi: So sánh chuỗi và toán tử logic
steps.content:
Use string_logic.sh to compare strings, combine conditions and detect an unset variable.

`~/project/string_logic.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
STRING1="hello"; STRING2="world"; NUMBER1=5; NUMBER2=10
if [ "$STRING1" = hello ] && [ "$STRING2" = world ]; then echo "Both strings match"; fi
if [ "$NUMBER1" -lt 10 ] || [ "$NUMBER2" -gt 5 ]; then echo "At least one of the number conditions is true"; fi
if [[ "$STRING1" != "$STRING2" ]]; then echo "The strings are different"; fi
if [[ -z "$STRING3" ]]; then echo "STRING3 is empty or not set"; fi
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/string_logic.sh
~/project/string_logic.sh 
```

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/string_logic.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['&&', '||', '!=', '-z']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['Both strings match', 'The strings are different', 'STRING3 is empty or not set']),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK
